python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

img15 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0015.png')

# Plant pot bottom contact
pot = (img15[:, :, 2] > 120) & (img15[:, :, 0] < 60) & (img15[:, :, 1] < 80)
y_p, x_p = np.where(pot)
print(f'Plant pot in obs_0015: x=[{np.min(x_p)}, {np.max(x_p)}], y=[{np.min(y_p)}, {np.max(y_p)}]')
# bottom-most pixels:
max_y = np.max(y_p)
print(f'Bottom contact row: {max_y}, center x: {np.mean(x_p[y_p == max_y])}')

# Floor lamp base disc in obs_0015:
disc_pts = []
for y in range(320, 360):
    for x in range(180, 250):
        c = img15[y, x]
        if c[0] < 125 and c[1] < 115 and abs(int(c[0])-int(c[1])) < 15 and c[2] < 115:
            disc_pts.append((x, y))

if disc_pts:
    xs, ys = zip(*disc_pts)
    print(f'Lamp base disc in obs_0015: x=[{min(xs)}, {max(xs)}], y=[{min(ys)}, {max(ys)}]')
    print(f'Center estimate: x={np.mean(xs):.1f}, y={np.mean(ys):.1f}')
"
input.description: Analyze plant and floor lamp in obs_0015
